title: India in January: Where to Go for Sun, Snow and Festivals
seo_title: India in January: Where to Go, Weather & Festivals
seo_desc: Where to go in India in January: sun in Kerala, Goa and Rajasthan, snow in Himachal, official temperatures, Republic Day and 2027 festival dates.
label: India in January
blurb: Sun in Kerala, Goa and Rajasthan, snow in Himachal, Republic Day and January 2027 festival dates
tag: January: warm south, snowy hills, festival dates.
sub: January is one of the best months for a first trip to India: the south and the desert are warm and dry, the Himalayan hill towns get their heaviest snow, and the calendar is full — Makar Sankranti, Pongal, Republic Day. Here is where the weather works, the official temperatures in °C and °F, and the January 2027 dates to plan around. Written by a travel company based in the Himalaya.
hero_alt: India Gate in New Delhi silhouetted against an orange dawn, snow on the rooftops of Shimla's hillside houses, houseboats on the Kerala backwaters at dusk and a camel on a dune in the Thar Desert under the stars
q: Is January a good time to visit India?
answer: Yes. January is one of the best months to visit India: Kerala, Goa and Rajasthan are dry and sunny, the Golden Triangle is pleasant by day, and the Himachal hills get their most snow — Shimla averages about 40 cm. Nights in the north are cold and fog can slow mornings. Republic Day is Tuesday 26 January 2027. Send us your dates for a quote.

sections.h2: Watching the Republic Day parade as a visitor
sections.lead: Foreign visitors can watch the parade in New Delhi with a ticket. This is how it has worked in recent years — check the official site for 2027:
items: Tickets go on sale in early January

India's Ministry of Defence sells tickets for the parade, the full-dress rehearsal of Beating Retreat and Beating Retreat itself, online on its booking portal and at counters in New Delhi. In 2025 the sale ran from 2 to 11 January. The 2027 dates are not out yet — check rashtraparv.mod.gov.in.
Carry your passport
An original photo ID — a passport is accepted — is needed to buy tickets at a counter and must be carried on the day. Children under five are not allowed.
Plan the day around it
We plan your Delhi sightseeing for the other days and time your car around the ceremony.
We can't buy tickets for you
Buy them yourself on the official portal or at the counters — seats are never guaranteed. We help with everything else — your hotel, car and the rest of the route.

sections.h2: Snow in January: the Himalayan hills
sections.lead: We are based in Himachal. January is the snowiest month in the hill towns — likely, but never certain on a given date. The India Meteorological Department's long-term figures for Shimla:
items: 50.5 °F — average January high
36.5 °F — average January low
≈40 cm
about 16 in — average snowfall in January
snow days a month in January–February
sections.note: In Manali, Himachal Pradesh Tourism says temperatures in December–January can fall below −5 °C (23 °F); the slopes at Solang, 13 km away, become a ski area in winter. Rohtang Pass is closed from late November until about May, but the Atal Tunnel keeps the road to Lahaul open. In Uttarakhand, Auli's ski season runs from December, with snow until March. More: where to see snow in India and Manali in January.

sections.h2: Sun in January: the south and the desert
sections.lead: If you are escaping winter at home, January is the heart of the best season for these:
items: Kerala

Kerala Tourism names November–February as peak season and October–February as the best time for houseboat cruises; December–February is mild. Up in Thekkady it can drop to 13 °C (55 °F), so pack a layer. See our houseboat guide.
Goa
Goa's foreign visitors come in winter, and Incredible India gives Palolem's best months as November to February.
Rajasthan
Clear, warm days and cold desert nights: Jaisalmer averages 4.6–29 °C (40–84 °F) in January, and Incredible India gives its best time as November to March. A desert camp night needs warm clothes.
The Golden Triangle

Delhi, Agra and Jaipur are dry and comfortable by day. Morning fog can delay early starts and sunrise at the Taj, so we keep spare time in the plan. The Taj Mahal opens 30 minutes before sunrise and is closed on Fridays.

sections.h2: What to plan around in January
items: Fog and night driving

The UK FCDO advises: 'Avoid travelling at night and in fog as accidents are common due to low visibility.' In January we plan daytime drives only and keep buffer time on long road days and early flights.
Cold mornings
The north is cold before sunrise and after dark, and the hills are colder still. Our India packing list covers layers for a winter trip.
Kashmir in deep winter

Srinagar averages about 2.5 °C (36.5 °F) in January, the heart of Chillai Kalan, the 40 harshest winter days (21 December–31 January), and Gulmarg's ski season runs mid-December to mid-April. The UK FCDO advises against all travel to Jammu and Kashmir except Jammu city, and the US State Department says 'Do not travel' to J&K except eastern Ladakh and Leh (advice checked 12 Nov 2026). Your travel insurance could be invalidated if you travel against FCDO advice. Check the latest before you book — see our Gulmarg guide.
Busy dates
The Kumbh bathing days in Haridwar, the literature festival in Jaipur and Republic Day in New Delhi are big occasions. If your dates touch them, book flights, hotels and your car early.

paras: February is just as good for most of India, and a little warmer. Shimla averages 3.3–11.5 °C (38–53 °F) with about 40 cm of snow, so the hills are still white; Kerala and Goa stay in season; Rajasthan's days warm up. In 2027 the Haridwar Kumbh continues through February and March. For a whole-year view, see our guide to the best time to visit India — and if you are coming earlier, India in December.

items: Visa

faqs: Is January a good time to visit India?

Yes, for most of the country. Kerala, Goa and Rajasthan are dry and sunny, the Golden Triangle is pleasant by day, and the Himachal hills get their heaviest snow. Plan for cold nights and morning fog in the north.
Where is it warm in India in January?

Kerala and Goa are warm and in peak season, and Rajasthan has warm, sunny days — Jodhpur averages up to 30 °C (86 °F) — with cold nights. Delhi, Agra and Jaipur are pleasant by day and cold early in the morning.
Does it snow in India in January?

Yes, in the Himalaya. The India Meteorological Department's average January snowfall in Shimla is about 40 cm (16 in), and Manali, Solang and Auli are snowy too. Snow is never guaranteed on a given date.
How cold is North India in January?

Shimla averages 2.5–10.3 °C (37–51 °F) in January, and Manali can fall below −5 °C (23 °F). On the plains days are mild but early mornings are cold and often foggy. Bring warm layers, a jacket and a hat.
What festivals are there in India in January 2027?

Makar Sankranti on Thursday 14 January (also the first bathing day of the Haridwar Ardh Kumbh), Pongal on Friday 15 January, the Jaipur Literature Festival on 14–18 January (as reported) and Republic Day on Tuesday 26 January.
Can tourists watch the Republic Day parade?

Yes, with a ticket. India's Ministry of Defence sells parade and Beating Retreat tickets online and at New Delhi counters in early January; carry your passport. The 2027 sale dates are not out yet — check rashtraparv.mod.gov.in.
Is Kerala or Goa better in January?

Both are in season. Kerala suits backwaters, tea hills and culture; Goa suits beaches and a slower pace. Either pairs well with the Golden Triangle — tell us what you enjoy and we suggest the better fit.
How do I book a January trip?
Send your dates, how many of you and what you'd like to see. We reply with a route, a day-by-day plan and a US-dollar quote. A 20% deposit locks your dates and price.
